properties.description:
Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 linked service for the Gold container (evdatalakedev2).

Authentication : Azure Key Vault secret for the storage account key.
Used by        : ds_gold_blob_sink — blob file migration into the gold container.

NOTE: If your ADF already has an ADLS Gen2 linked service pointing to
evdatalakedev2 (e.g. ls_adls_ev or ls_adls_gen2), reuse that one in
ds_gold_blob_sink instead of creating a new linked service.
Both silver and gold containers live on the same storage account so
one linked service can serve both — just update the dataset's fileSystem
property to 'gold' or 'silver' as needed.
